title: Teacher Training Near Ayapakkam, Chennai
metaDescription: Teacher training institute near Ayapakkam, Chennai — SPEDICS offers Montessori, child psychology, special education and skill courses with online and offline modes.
intro: If you live in or near Ayapakkam and are looking for a teacher training institute, location matters for offline classes, counselling visits and practical sessions. SPEDICS Institute of Skill Development is based in Ayapakkam and serves learners across north Chennai and surrounding areas.

sections.heading: SPEDICS location and areas served
sections.content: SPEDICS is located at 4021, 6th Main Road, Ayapakkam, Chennai – 600077. The institute serves learners from Ayapakkam and nearby areas including Ambattur, Avadi, Padi, Mogappair, Thirumullaivoyal and Anna Nagar. Online and hybrid modes are available if you prefer learning from home.
